native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the stone with the smallest owed letter (repeatedly settle the minimum tentative distance among unlocked nodes).
Threads cast from a tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (relax each outgoing directed edge, weight applied per direction).
A locked letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped and thrown away (settled nodes are final; superseded/unreachable entries are discarded).
core_technique: Dijkstra's algorithm over a CSR graph with a density switch: 4-ary lazy-deletion binary-heap Dijkstra for sparse graphs (the default path) and a textbook O(n^2) SIMD/AVX2 linear argmin scan over unsettled nodes for dense graphs.
